derivation:
by ext x; apply Subtype.ext
   simpa using congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) (Rep.norm_comm ((Rep.resFunctor S.subtype).map f)).symm
explanation: Apply norm naturality to f restricted to S. Extensionality on coinvariant generators and subtype extensionality reduce the claimed equality to this instance. Rep.norm_comm is proved independently by expanding the norm sum.
